newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees no quick solution in Vietnam oil row.
newsitem.headline: China sees no quick solution in Vietnam oil row.

text.p: China said on Thursday that talks with Vietnam to resolve a dispute over oil drilling off the Vietnamese coast had resulted in greater understanding but warned that differences would take time to iron out.
"The two sides have reached a greater understanding of each other's positions," Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang said of expert-level talks that began on Wednesday in Beijing.
"We hope that we can resolve our differences through peaceful discussion," Shen told a news briefing.
"But some differences cannot be resolved immediately," he said. "We hope this will not affect the friendly relations between our two countries."
Shen said he expected the talks to end shortly.

Teams of negotiators from the two sides gathered at a Beijing hotel for a second day of talks on Thursday, but both Chinese and Vietnamese officials declined to comment on the content of the discussions.
